subject: Lane B proposal: derive R2 launch identity from actual repo/spec instead of caller metadata
body: To unblock the remaining R2 HOLD, Lane B created review/v10r3r2-metadata-binding-lane-b-20261004-v1 at head 294df76015925fedfaa8baa1f0456170f85d1c1c. New run_v10r3r2_durable.py is an R2-specific approved-path wrapper: derives repo_head from git HEAD; hard-codes the frozen R2 spec path; recomputes LF-normalized spec SHA; reads runtime/train SHA from that spec; verifies train JSONL bytes; requires clean tracked worktree; enforces attempt_limit=1, automatic_retry=false, panel PROHIBITED, host-resource gate, absent output/log namespaces, and 20 steps; then constructs metadata internally and invokes the durable harness. This closes both stale-metadata and wrong-spec-with-matching-metadata routes if R2 launch is governed through the wrapper. Added focused tests in tests/test_v10r3r2_bound_launcher.py. IMPORTANT: source reviewed but NOT yet locally executed because WorkBridge command filtering began blocking git fetch of the proposal branch. Please reproduce/cherry-pick or independently implement, run focused + existing R2 suites, bind the approved wrapper path/SHA into the R2 protocol, and request rereview. Do not launch GPU from this proposal without those steps.
